title: FC A04: Administrative Services
officialText:
A04.1 Fees for administrative services.

Fees for administrative services shall be as follows:

Fee

1.Transcripts and special reports (per transcript or special report) (per premises)

$10.00

2.Replacement of lost permit or certificate

$5.00

3.Application for modification of certificate (except certificate of approval)

$5.00

4.Violation dismissal notice (per violation)

$5.00

5.Application for modification

$200.00

6.Removal and storage of contraband material (per article, device or equipment reclaimed)

$65.00

7.Payment returned for insufficient funds (per item)

$20.00

8.Vacate order processing (upon dismissal for compliance)

$525.00

9.Document management for fire alarm system, emergency alarm system, auxiliary radio communication system or fire extinguishing system application and for any other application not requiring a work permit from the Department of Buildings (per application)

$165.00

10.Certification of corrected defects in fire alarm system installations (per certification)

Certification of defects with or without documentation

$210.00

Certification of required documentation only

$105.00

11.Project authorization

$105.00
